items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, so that a team's onsite days overlap and the office time is actually collaborative; most teams anchor on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

Next steps:
- Make benefits elections in MosaicOne within 30 days of eligibility
- Contact People Operations with benefits questions

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for credentials, payment changes, or bulk personal-data extracts over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

Recommendation — not company policy: Do not reply to the message and do not act on the request. Forward it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it. The security team answers every report, including ones that turn out to be legitimate mail.

Next steps:
- Forward to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply or act on it

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, or small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over. It is available to hybrid and fully remote employees; onsite employees may claim against it only where their manager has agreed a regular remote pattern in MosaicOne.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Next steps:
- Review eligible items in MosaicOne Expenses
- Submit claim before 31 December for current year

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Confirm eligibility (6 months continuous service)
- Coordinate timing with your manager

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Check MosaicOne Travel for your destination's applicable cap
- Note the reason if booking above cap

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires approval from three separate sources: your director, Tax & Legal, and your direct manager. All three approvals must be in place before departure.

Tax & Legal must conduct a review to determine whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether your planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request names the destination, exact dates, workspace address, and a description of the work you will perform while abroad.

You must hold the right to work in the destination country, meet the device and connectivity requirements, and stay inside the company's rolling 90-day annual limit.

Next steps:
- File Tax & Legal review request 21+ days before travel
- Obtain director and manager approvals
- Confirm device and connectivity compliance

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

Expense reports of USD 2,501 to USD 10,000 require director approval and a Finance business partner review.

Days since the transaction: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager and director.

Next steps:
- Submit the claim in MosaicOne with itemised receipts.
- Route to Dana (your director Dana) for approval.
- Confirm Finance business partner review is complete.

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date.

All four required trainings — security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption — must be completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one, and the employee has 30 days from the end of the 90-day waiting period to make elections in MosaicOne Benefits.

Standard equipment — laptop, power adapter, headset and laptop bag — is issued to every employee. A 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory is the standard for engineering roles.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date.

Next steps:
- Complete security training by day 14
- Complete all required training by day 30
- Make benefits elections within 30 days of day 90

Company laptops are refreshed on a 36-month cycle. MosaicOne opens a refresh ticket automatically 60 days before the anniversary, and IT arranges the swap at a time you choose.

A standard laptop refresh at the end of its cycle requires no approval. However, if you request an early refresh before the 36-month cycle completes, your direct manager must approve it.

All company equipment must be returned within 5 business days of your final day of employment. IT will send you a prepaid, tracked shipping label if you are remote, or you hand equipment to your local IT desk if onsite.

Next steps:
- Contact IT to schedule the swap at your preferred time.
- Copy personal files from the old device before return.

Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours. Response means a named human being contacting the person who raised the case, acknowledging what was raised, naming who owns it and describing what happens next.

Target resolution time for Severity 1 cases is as fast as the facts allow. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update, with updates continuing at least every 10 business days until the case closes.

Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations if your case is not acknowledged within 4 business hours.

You are assigned to the Boston office and your manager Dana is Dana, Director, Engineering.

As a hybrid employee assigned to a hub office, you are expected on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by your team to ensure onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative.

The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne rather than week by week, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem. Weeks containing a company holiday, approved PTO or approved travel reduce the requirement proportionally.

Next steps:
- Confirm your team's onsite days with Dana

You have 13.5 remaining PTO days.

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on your office calendar.

Your direct manager, Dana, approves PTO requests up to 5 consecutive business days with 5 business days' notice. Requests of 6 to 15 consecutive business days also require 15 business days' notice. Requests of more than 15 consecutive business days require director approval in addition to your manager's approval.

Next steps:
- Submit PTO requests in MosaicOne with required advance notice
- Discuss longer requests (16+ days) with Dana and your director

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins.

Your trip is 20 consecutive days (1 October to 20 October 2026), which does not exceed the 30-day threshold.

Shorter stays require only direct-manager approval, and every stay of any length must satisfy device and connectivity requirements.

Always-on VPN is required whenever a company device connects to a network that Mosaic Robotics does not control, including home networks, hotel and airport networks, and coworking spaces.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with the exact dates and workspace address, and obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and configured for always-on VPN before you depart.

Company-managed laptop with full-disk encryption and always-on VPN: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager.

Next steps:
- Submit request in MosaicOne with dates and workspace address.
- Obtain manager approval from Dana at least 21 calendar days before 1 October.
- Confirm laptop encryption and VPN with IT Security.

You must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside your home country. You have 3 years 9 months of tenure, so this requirement is met.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Your trip is 42 calendar days, so this requirement is met.

Germany is on the approved-country list for temporary work abroad.

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. Your 42-day trip exceeds this threshold, so Tax & Legal review is mandatory.

Stays exceeding 30 consecutive days require approval from your director and from Tax & Legal, not just your direct manager. The Manager Approval Matrix routes such requests to a director.

Written manager approval and Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. You have 42 calendar days' notice (Tuesday 22 September to Tuesday 3 November), so this requirement is met.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside your home country.

You may not sign contracts or negotiate customer agreements on behalf of Mosaic Robotics while abroad. As a Senior Robotics Engineer in an engineering role, this carries very little permanent-establishment risk.

Screens showing Confidential or Restricted material must not be visible to other people. Privacy filters are issued on request and are expected on any device used regularly in transit. Confidential conversations do not happen in public places such as trains, open cafés or shared lounges.

Recommendation — not company policy: Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with the exact dates (3 November to 14 December 2026) and the address of your workspace in Berlin.

Recommendation — not company policy: File a Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at the same time, naming the destination, exact dates, workspace address and a description of the work you will perform.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with IT Security at least 5 business days before departure that your travel laptop is company-managed, encrypted and configured with always-on VPN.

Company-managed laptop with full-disk encryption and always-on VPN: not verified from your record — confirm before you proceed.

Your request goes to Dana, your direct manager and director.

Next steps:
- Raise the request in MosaicOne with exact dates and workspace address.
- File Tax & Legal review request with the same details.
- Confirm travel laptop setup with IT Security 5 business days before departure.

Your benefits waiting period ends on 13 November 2026.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, a promotion, or a change from part-time to full-time status. It is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Recommendation — not company policy: You have 30 days from 13 November to make benefits elections in MosaicOne Benefits. If you make no election within that window, you will be enrolled in employee-only coverage on the standard medical plan by default and may not change it until the next open enrollment or a qualifying life event.

Next steps:
- Log into MosaicOne Benefits after 13 November
- Attend a benefits question session (every second Tuesday)
- Make your elections before 13 December
